g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS IoT telemetry with Greengrass, IoT Core rules, Timestream and Grafana

g.title: None.None.Node.25
g.text: Turbine sensors report to the Greengrass gateway at the wind farm
which publishes readings to AWS IoT Core over MQTT with its device certificate
An IoT rule sends them to Kinesis Data Streams
Lambda functions in the VPC read batches, clean and aggregate them
and write them to Timestream through the interface endpoint
Operators watch them in Amazon Managed Grafana
Alarm messages match a second rule
which feeds an IoT Events detector model for each turbine
An over-speed state notifies operators through SNS
A third rule sends every message to Firehose
which writes it to the S3 archive, partitioned by day
